en.title: Scientific Alert: Air Fryer Aerodynamic Suction & Heating Coil Fire Hazards
en.body: Air fryers generate powerful convective air vortexes (300–400 CFM). Placing lightweight parchment paper in an air fryer without sufficient ballast weight creates immediate aerodynamic lift: the suction draws the paper straight into the glowing nichrome heating coil (400°C–600°C / 750°F–1100°F), causing spontaneous ignition within 3 to 7 seconds (CPSC Appliance Hazard Reports). Solid silicone pots eliminate fire risk but restrict convective bottom airflow by up to 55%, extending cook times and creating soggy bottoms.

es.title: Alerta Científica: Succión Aerodinámica en Freidoras de Aire y Riesgo de Incendio
es.body: Las freidoras de aire generan vórtices de convección de alta velocidad (300–400 CFM). Colocar papel pergamino sin suficiente peso de comida crea una sustentación aerodinámica inmediata: el flujo succiona el papel directamente contra la resistencia incandescente (400°C–600°C), provocando ignición en 3 a 7 segundos (CPSC). Los moldes de silicona macizos evitan el fuego pero bloquean hasta un 55% del flujo inferior, haciendo la comida blanda.

pt.title: Alerta Científico: Sucção Aerodinâmica em Air Fryers e Risco de Incêndio na Resistência
pt.body: Air fryers produzem vórtices de convecção intensos (300–400 CFM). Usar papel manteiga/pergaminho sem peso de lastro suficiente gera sucção aerodinâmica que puxa o papel diretamente para a serpentina incandescente (400°C–600°C), causando fogo aberto em 3 a 7 segundos (relatórios CPSC). Já cestos de silicone sólidos eliminam o risco de fogo, mas bloqueiam até 55% da circulação inferior, retardando o cozimento.

zh-cn.title: 科学警示：空气炸锅高速气流气动吸附与发热管起火隐患
zh-cn.body: 空气炸锅内部产生高达 300–400 CFM 的强对流涡流。在预热或缺少足够食物压重时放入烘焙纸，极易因伯努利气动效应被强力吸附至顶部裸露的镍铬发热管（温度达 400°C–600°C），在 3 至 7 秒内发生焦糊自燃甚至引发机体火灾（美国 CPSC 召回通报）。全封闭硅胶内胆虽无起火风险，但会阻断底层高达 55% 的循环热风，导致食物底部湿软夹生。

ja.title: 科学的警告：ノンフライヤー（エアフライヤー）気流吸引による電熱線発火リスク
ja.body: エアフライヤーは強力な高速熱風渦（300〜400 CFM）を循環させます。食材の重石（200g以上）がない状態でクッキングシートを敷くと、空力吸引によりシートが浮き上がり、400℃〜600℃の高温ヒーター（電熱线）に直接接触して数秒で発火する火災事故が多発しています（米CPSC警告）。一方、底面が密閉されたシリコン製ポットは発火を防ぐものの、下部気流を最大55%遮断し加熱ムラを生みます。

empty_preheat.mechanism: Vortex suction pulls lightweight paper (3–5g) directly into the glowing 550°C heating element in 3.2 seconds, causing instantaneous open flames and dense smoke.
empty_preheat.actionRequired: NEVER put parchment paper into an air fryer during preheating. Only insert once food is placed on top.

light_food.mechanism: Food mass (<100g) is insufficient to pin outer edges down. High-velocity air flips unweighted paper margins upward into the radiant coil.
light_food.actionRequired: Ensure parchment paper is trimmed flush with the food or use a perforated silicone liner.

standard_food.mechanism: Food weight (225g) pins central zone down, but perimeter corners may curl and char if untrimmed.
standard_food.actionRequired: Trim excess paper edges so they do not extend above the rim of the basket.

dense_heavy_food.mechanism: Weight of food completely suppresses aerodynamic lift. Safe operation up to 425°F (218°C).
dense_heavy_food.actionRequired: Safe to proceed. Flip food at halfway point to ensure even bottom crisping.

max_temp_broil.mechanism: Ambient air reaches 450°F, exceeding parchment silicone coating stability (428°F). Paper turns brittle, browns, and releases pyrolysis smoke.
max_temp_broil.actionRequired: Lower temperature to 400°F (205°C) or switch to heavy duty aluminum foil or platinum silicone.

empty_preheat.mechanism: Even with perforations, air drag on unweighted paper is sufficient to loft it into the top heating coil during preheat.
empty_preheat.actionRequired: Never preheat with empty perforated parchment paper in the basket.

light_food.mechanism: Perforations allow airflow passage, reducing lift forces by 45% compared to solid sheets, but edge flap risk remains if food is too sparse.
light_food.actionRequired: Distribute food evenly across all four quadrants of the perforated sheet.

standard_food.mechanism: Optimal balance: food weight immobilizes paper while perforations maintain 90% convective bottom airflow for crisp results.
standard_food.actionRequired: Gold standard for air frying: safe, nonstick, and excellent bottom crispness.

dense_heavy_food.mechanism: Heavy mass holds paper flat against basket grid. Zero lift risk and full grease drainage through perforations.

max_temp_broil.mechanism: At 450°F, paper edges darken and become brittle. No open fire if weighted, but scorch particles may transfer to food.
max_temp_broil.actionRequired: Limit cooking duration to under 15 minutes at >425°F when using parchment paper.

empty_preheat.mechanism: Heavy silicone mass (120–180g) cannot be lifted by fan airflow. Withstands empty preheat up to 450°F without scorching.
empty_preheat.actionRequired: Safe from fire, but thermal mass absorbs initial heat, delaying cooking chamber preheating.

light_food.mechanism: Zero fire hazard. However, solid high walls prevent hot air from swirling underneath food, trapping steam and softening crust.
light_food.actionRequired: Add 2–4 minutes to cooking time and shake basket frequently.

standard_food.mechanism: Complete fire safety. Rendered fat and water pool in bottom grooves; underside does not reach Maillard crisping temperature without flipping.
standard_food.actionRequired: Flip food halfway through and extend total cooking duration by 20–30%.

dense_heavy_food.mechanism: Zero fire hazard. Meat juices collect at base; behaves more like a baking dish than a convection crisper.
dense_heavy_food.actionRequired: Drain pooled fat midway or flip meat to brown the underside.

max_temp_broil.mechanism: Food-grade silicone handles 450°F safely. Cheap peroxide-cured silicone with mineral fillers may emit odor ("pinch test" turns white).
max_temp_broil.actionRequired: Only use FDA 21 CFR § 177.2600 / LFGB platinum silicone certified for 450°F.

empty_preheat.mechanism: Silicone density (40–60g) combined with perforated mesh prevents aerodynamic lofting under preheat vortex.
empty_preheat.actionRequired: Safe, but best practice is to leave basket bare during preheat for fastest heating.

light_food.mechanism: Non-slip silicone grip and perforated airflow prevent curling or lifting even with very light food.
light_food.actionRequired: Excellent choice for kale chips, croutons, and dehydrating fruit slices.

standard_food.mechanism: Maintains 85% convective bottom airflow while preventing food from sticking to metal basket grates. Reusable and eco-friendly.
standard_food.actionRequired: Top eco-friendly recommendation: preserves crispness and protects non-stick basket coating.

dense_heavy_food.mechanism: Full stability and airflow preservation. Grease drains into bottom drawer cleanly.
dense_heavy_food.actionRequired: Optimal operation. Wash with warm soapy water after use.

max_temp_broil.mechanism: Platinum silicone withstands 450°F without degradation or toxic volatile release.
max_temp_broil.actionRequired: Safe for broiling. Avoid sharp knives on silicone mat surface.

empty_preheat.mechanism: Lightweight foil sheets can be whipped up by fan turbulence. Touching glowing nichrome coils can cause electrical sparking / short circuits.
empty_preheat.actionRequired: Never put unweighted, uncrimped foil in an air fryer. Always mold edges tightly around basket perimeter.

light_food.mechanism: Foil edges can flap in high turbulence and contact the top coil or fan blades.
light_food.actionRequired: Crimp foil tightly to the basket walls so no loose flaps protrude upward.

standard_food.mechanism: Food weight prevents movement. Foil blocks bottom convective holes completely, redirecting heat upward and trapping liquid grease.
standard_food.actionRequired: Do not use foil with acidic foods (tomato sauce, lemon marinades) to prevent aluminum leaching.

dense_heavy_food.mechanism: Completely stable under food weight. Foil reflects radiant heat upward, speeding surface browning while reducing bottom crispness.
dense_heavy_food.actionRequired: Great for messy ribs or roasts; avoid acidic glazes directly on foil.

max_temp_broil.mechanism: Aluminum melting point is 1220°F (660°C). Completely heat-safe at 450°F, but loose foil wings must not touch heating element.
max_temp_broil.actionRequired: Check that foil is at least 2 inches away from the top heating coil.

empty_preheat.mechanism: Paraffin wax has a melting point of 130°F (54°C) and an auto-ignition temperature of ~390°F (199°C). The wax vaporizes instantly and catches fire.
empty_preheat.actionRequired: ABSOLUTE CRITICAL BAN: Never use wax paper in an air fryer under any circumstances. Fire hazard is guaranteed.

light_food.mechanism: Melted paraffin petroleum wax smokes violently, coating food in toxic hydrocarbons and flashing into flames as temperature hits 350°F.
light_food.actionRequired: REMOVE IMMEDIATELY. Wax paper is NOT heat-resistant and is not parchment paper.

standard_food.mechanism: Even weighted down, paraffin wax melts into food at 130°F and smokes intensely at 300°F+, releasing acrid fumes and creating severe fire danger.
standard_food.actionRequired: NEVER USE. Discard any food prepared with wax paper in high-temperature appliances.

dense_heavy_food.mechanism: Paraffin wax liquefies, saturates food surface, drains into bottom pan and creates a volatile oil/wax fire vapor layer inside the chamber.
dense_heavy_food.actionRequired: DO NOT USE. Use certified parchment paper or platinum silicone instead.

max_temp_broil.mechanism: Instantaneous ignition. Severe risk of appliance destruction and structural kitchen fire.
max_temp_broil.actionRequired: EXTINGUISH/UNPLUG APPLIANCE if wax paper was mistakenly inserted and smoke appears.

en.question: Can parchment paper catch fire in an air fryer?
en.answer: Yes. Standard parchment paper has a maximum rated heat resistance of 428°F to 450°F (220°C–232°C). In an air fryer, high-velocity convective fans (300–400 CFM) create aerodynamic lift. If parchment paper is placed in the basket without sufficient food weight (minimum 200g / 7 oz) or during preheating, the vortex draws the paper straight into the glowing nichrome heating coil (400°C–600°C / 750°F–1100°F). It will ignite into open flames within 3 to 7 seconds. Never preheat an air fryer with loose parchment paper.

en.question: Why do silicone pots make food soggy in an air fryer?
en.answer: Air fryers work on convection thermodynamics, circulating superheated air through the perforations in the crisper basket to remove boundary-layer moisture and crisp the food from all 360 degrees. Solid silicone bowls block 50% to 55% of this vertical airflow, converting the appliance into a mini countertop oven. Juices and rendered fats pool at the bottom rather than draining away, leading to soggy bottoms and requiring up to 25% to 35% longer cook times unless food is flipped manually.

en.question: What is the difference between parchment paper and wax paper?
en.answer: Parchment paper is pure vegetable cellulose treated with acid and coated with food-grade silicone, making it heat-resistant up to 428°F–450°F and naturally non-stick. Wax paper is coated with paraffin wax (a petroleum byproduct) which melts at just 130°F–150°F (54°C–65°C). Wax paper cannot withstand oven or air fryer temperatures: the wax liquefies into food, smokes heavily at 300°F, and auto-ignites into flames around 390°F. Never put wax paper in an air fryer.

en.question: Does parchment paper contain toxic PFAS chemicals?
en.answer: Authentic genuine vegetable parchment paper (such as Reynolds, If You Care, or FSC-certified brands) is coated with inert food-grade silicone and is 100% PFAS-free. However, cheap uncertified grease-resistant papers or fast-food wrapper liners historically used fluorochemical coatings (PFAS) to repel oil. Always look for packaging labeled 'PFAS-Free', 'Unbleached', or compliant with FDA 21 CFR § 176.170.

en.question: How much food weight is required to safely hold down air fryer parchment paper?
en.answer: Aerodynamic physics calculations indicate that a minimum ballast weight of 150 to 200 grams (approx. 5.3 to 7 oz) of food evenly distributed across the paper is required to overcome the suction force of a 3,000 RPM convective fan. For lightweight items like kale chips, pita chips, or single slices of bread, use a perforated silicone mesh mat or place an oven-safe stainless steel fork/trivet across the food to prevent paper lofting.

en.question: Are reusable silicone air fryer liners safe from toxic chemical leaching?
en.answer: High-quality food-grade silicone (specifically platinum-cured silicone certified under FDA 21 CFR § 177.2600 and European LFGB standards) is chemically inert, BPA-free, and safe up to 450°F (232°C). However, cheap counterfeit silicone liners cured with peroxide or bulked with mineral/plastic fillers can offgas cyclic siloxane oligomers (D4, D5, D6) at high temperatures. Perform the 'pinch test': twist the silicone firmly; if white color shows through the fold, it contains cheap fillers and should not be heated.

es.question: ¿Puede el papel pergamino incendiarse en una freidora de aire?
es.answer: Sí. El papel pergamino resiste hasta 220 °C (428 °F). En una freidora de aire, el ventilador de alta velocidad genera succión aerodinámica. Si se introduce papel sin peso suficiente de comida (mínimo 200 g) o durante el precalentamiento, el vórtice succiona el papel directamente contra la resistencia incandescente (400 °C–600 °C), provocando llamas en 3 a 7 segundos. Nunca precaliente la freidora con papel pergamino suelto.

es.question: ¿Por qué los moldes de silicona hacen que la comida quede blanda en la air fryer?
es.answer: La freidora de aire funciona mediante convección forzada 360°, requiriendo que el aire pase por los orificios del cesto para evaporar la humedad superficial. Los recipientes de silicona macizos bloquean del 50% al 55% de este flujo de aire inferior, atrapando grasas y vapores como si fuera un horno convencional, lo que genera fondos blandos y aumenta el tiempo de cocción entre un 25% y un 35%.

es.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre papel pergamino y papel encerado?
es.answer: El papel pergamino es celulosa vegetal tratada y recubierta con silicona alimentaria, resistente hasta 220 °C. El papel encerado está recubierto con parafina derivada del petróleo que se derrite a solo 54 °C–65 °C (130 °F–150 °F). Al meterse en la freidora de aire, la cera se derrite sobre la comida, produce humo tóxico y entra en autocombustión hacia los 199 °C (390 °F). Jamás use papel encerado.

es.question: ¿El papel pergamino contiene sustancias químicas PFAS?
es.answer: El papel pergamino auténtico con recubrimiento de silicona (marcas certificadas FSC o FDA 21 CFR § 176.170) es 100% libre de PFAS. No obstante, papeles antigrasa genéricos o importados sin certificación históricamente usaban fluoropolímeros. Verifique siempre que el envase indique 'Libre de PFAS' o 'Sin blanquear'.

es.question: ¿Cuánto peso de comida se necesita para sujetar el papel con seguridad?
es.answer: Se requiere un peso mínimo de 150 a 200 gramos de comida distribuidos uniformemente para contrarrestar la succión de un ventilador de 3.000 RPM. Para alimentos ligeros (chips de verduras, una rebanada de pan), utilice tapetes de silicona perforada o coloque una rejilla de acero inoxidable apta para horno encima.

es.question: ¿Son seguros los moldes de silicona reutilizables frente a la migración química?
es.answer: La silicona de grado alimentario curada al platino (certificada por FDA 21 CFR § 177.2600 y LFGB alemana) es químicamente inerte y segura hasta 232 °C. Sin embargo, productos baratos con cargas de plástico o curadas con peróxido pueden liberar oligómeros volátiles de siloxano. Haga la 'prueba del pellizco': retuerza la silicona firmemente; si se torna blanca en el pliegue, contiene rellenos baratos y no debe calentarse.

pt.question: O papel manteiga/pergaminho pode pegar fogo na air fryer?
pt.answer: Sim. O papel pergamino culinário suporta até 220 °C (428 °F). Na air fryer, ventiladores de alta rotação criam forte sucção aerodinâmica. Se colocado sem comida suficiente para pesar (mínimo de 200 g) ou durante o pré-aquecimento, o papel é puxado contra a resistência elétrica (400 °C–600 °C), entrando em combustão em 3 a 7 segundos. Nunca pré-aqueça com papel solto no cesto.

pt.question: Por que potes de silicone deixam a comida murcha na air fryer?
pt.answer: A air fryer depende do fluxo de convecção em 360° passando pelos furos do cesto metálico para secar a superfície e criar crocância. Os cestos de silicone com laterais e fundos sólidos bloqueiam de 50% a 55% dessa circulação inferior, retendo líquidos e gorduras no fundo. Isso prolonga o preparo em até 35% e exige virar os alimentos manualmente.

pt.question: Qual é a diferença entre papel pergaminho e papel encerado?
pt.answer: O papel pergaminho/vegetal é tratado e revestido com silicone atóxico resistente ao calor (até 220 °C). O papel encerado é revestido com parafina de petróleo, que derrete entre 54 °C e 65 °C. Na air fryer, a parafina derrete sobre os alimentos, libera fumaça escura e entra em autocombustão em torno de 199 °C. Jamais use papel encerado em fornos ou air fryers.

pt.question: O papel pergaminho contém químicos tóxicos PFAS?
pt.answer: O papel pergaminho culinário autêntico revestido de silicone é 100% livre de PFAS (conforme FDA 21 CFR § 176.170). Contudo, papéis antigordura industriais de procedência duvidosa usavam fluorocarbonetos. Prefira marcas com selo FSC, não branqueadas e que atestem ser livres de PFAS.

pt.question: Qual o peso mínimo de alimento para segurar o papel com segurança?
pt.answer: Cálculos de engenharia aerodinâmica indicam que são necessários ao menos 150 a 200 gramas de alimentos distribuídos por todo o papel para vencer a força de sustentação do ventilador de 3.000 RPM. Para alimentos leves como torradas ou chips de vegetais, utilize tapetes de silicone perfurados.

pt.question: Os forros de silicone reutilizáveis são seguros contra liberação química?
pt.answer: O silicone de cura platina aprovado pela FDA (21 CFR § 177.2600) e LFGB é inerte e seguro até 232 °C. Por outro lado, silicones de baixa qualidade com cargas minerais podem volatilizar oligômeros de siloxano. Faça o 'teste da torção': torça o silicone; se a dobra ficar esbranquiçada, o material contém cargas sintéticas e não deve ir ao calor intenso.

zh-cn.question: 空气炸锅专用烘焙纸会引发火灾吗？
zh-cn.answer: 会，而且极为常见。标准食品级烘焙纸耐温上限为 220°C（428°F）。空气炸锅内部拥有 3,000 RPM 的高速强力对流风机。如果在空机预热时放入烘焙纸，或食物重量不足（低于 200 克），纸张会被气流瞬间吹起并牢固吸附在顶部 400°C–600°C 的发热管上，在 3 至 7 秒内剧烈起火甚至烧毁机身。严禁在预热期间放置未压重的烘焙纸。

zh-cn.question: 为什么硅胶内胆会让空气炸锅烤出的食物变软甚至出水？
zh-cn.answer: 空气炸锅的核心脆化原理是依靠热风透过炸篮网孔在食材底部形成 360 度湍流，带走水汽并实现美拉德反应。全封闭的硅胶烘烤锅会阻隔 50%–55% 的垂直底部对流热风，使析出的油脂和水分积存在锅底，空气炸锅实际退化为普通对流小烤箱，烹饪时间需延长 25%–35% 且底层易湿软夹生。

zh-cn.question: 烘焙油纸（硅油纸）与石蜡纸有什么本质区别？
zh-cn.answer: 烘焙油纸是经过酸处理的纯植物纤维素原纸，涂有食品级耐热硅油，耐温达 220°C。而石蜡纸涂覆的是石油石蜡，熔点仅为 54°C–65°C。放入空气炸锅后石蜡会瞬间融化渗入食物，并在 150°C 以上剧烈冒烟，在约 199°C 发生自燃爆燃。绝对严禁在任何烤箱或空气炸锅中使用石蜡纸。

zh-cn.question: 空气炸锅烘焙纸是否含有全氟化合物（PFAS）？
zh-cn.answer: 正规合格的食品级硅油涂层原木浆烘焙纸（符合 FDA 21 CFR § 176.170 标准）是不含任何 PFAS 氟化物的。但历史上部分廉价快餐防油纸曾使用含氟防油剂。选购时应认准包装注明“100%原木浆”、“无氟涂层（PFAS-Free）”及 FSC 森林认证产品。

zh-cn.question: 需要压多少重量的食物才能确保烘焙纸不被风机吸起？
zh-cn.answer: 根据气动力学计算，必须在烘焙纸表面均匀铺放至少 150 至 200 克（约半磅）的高密度食材，才能抵消 3,000 RPM 风机产生的伯努利上浮升力。对于烤吐司、羽衣甘蓝脆片或单根香肠等轻飘食材，切勿使用烘焙纸，应改用有重量的多孔硅胶垫或用耐高温不锈钢叉压实。

zh-cn.question: 重复使用的硅胶空气炸锅垫是否会高温释放有毒化学物质？
zh-cn.answer: 经 FDA 21 CFR § 177.2600 及德国 LFGB 认证的铂金硫化食品级硅胶在 232°C 以下是极其稳定的，不含双酚A且耐温安全。但劣质过氧化物硫化或掺有碳酸钙填料的硅胶在高温下会挥发出环状硅氧烷低聚物。可通过“扭折白化测试”鉴别：用力拧折硅胶，若折痕明显泛白，说明掺杂了廉价劣质填料，严禁用于高温烹饪。

ja.question: エアフライヤーでクッキングシートが発火することはありますか？
ja.answer: はい、非常に危険な火災原因となります。市販の耐熱クッキングシートは耐熱温度が約220℃（428°F）です。エアフライヤー内部は3,000 RPMの強力な対流ファンが作動しており、予熱中や食材の重み（200g未満）が足りない状態で敷くと、気流によってシートが浮き上がり、400℃〜600℃に達する上部ヒーター電熱線に直接接触して3〜7秒で引火します。食材を乗せない予熱時は絶対に敷かないでください。

ja.question: シリコン製ポットを使うと食材の下側がベチャつくのはなぜですか？
ja.answer: エアフライヤーはバスケットの底網から熱風を循環させて食材の余分な水分を飛ばし、360度全体をパリッと仕上げます。底が塞がったシリコンポットは下部の熱風循環を50%〜55%遮断し、食材から出た水分や油分が底に溜まるため、実質的にスチーム蒸し状態になり、調理時間が25%〜35%延びる原因になります。

ja.question: クッキングシートとワックスペーパー（パラフィン紙）の違いは何ですか？
ja.answer: クッキングシートは植物性セルロースに耐熱シリコーンを塗布したもので約220℃まで安全です。一方、ワックスペーパーは石油系パラフィンを塗布したもので、耐熱温度はわずか54℃〜65℃です。エアフライヤーに入れるとワックスが溶けて食材に付着し、150℃以上で白煙を上げ、約199℃で発火します。加熱調理器具には絶対に使用しないでください。

ja.question: エアフライヤー用シートには有害なPFAS（有機フッ素化合物）が含まれていますか？
ja.answer: 正規の食品グレード・シリコーン塗布クッキングシート（米FDA 21 CFR § 176.170適合品）はPFASフリー（フッ素不使用）で安全です。しかし、一部の海外製粗悪な耐油紙には油を弾くためにPFASが使用されていた事例があります。「PFASフリー」「無漂白原木パルプ100%」と明記された製品をお選びください。

ja.question: シートがヒーターに巻き込まれないために必要な食材の重さはどのくらいですか？
ja.answer: 流体力学的な計算に基づくと、3,000 RPMの循環熱風による浮き上がりを防ぐには、シート全体に均等に最低150g〜200gの食材を載せる必要があります。食パン1枚やケールチップスなどの軽い食材を調理する際は、シートを使わず穴あきシリコンマットを使用するか、耐熱フォークなどで押さえてください。

ja.question: 繰り返し使えるシリコン製フライヤーライナーの化学物質溶出は安全ですか？
ja.answer: FDA（米食品医薬品局）およびドイツLFGB規格に合格した「白金（プラチナ）加硫シリコーン」は232℃まで化学的に不活性で安全です。しかし安価な粗悪品は炭酸カルシウムなどの増量剤が含まれ、加熱時にシロキサン低聚物が揮発する恐れがあります。「ピンチテスト（折り曲げテスト）」を行い、強くねじった際に折り目が白くなる製品は充填剤が混入しているため高温加熱を避けてください。
